title: 第9章 意外的相遇第10章 袁天罡带来的消息
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧风领着众人走在西城的街道上，看着周围鳞次栉比的商铺，几乎涵盖了武者修炼的所有东西，功法、丹药、武器、秘宝，只要你有钱，几乎能买到你想买到的一切，这里还有衍生出来的一些特殊职业，例如医师、毒师、阵法师等等。
这里还有很多世家和宗门的联络点，很多独自修炼的武者为了获得更好的修炼资源，只能投身这些世家和宗门，要不然就是参军，也能快速的获得皇家的奖励，但是参军毕竟风险要比这些宗门和世家要大。
萧风一行人走着走着，看到了一个五层楼的建筑，这个建筑就是他目之所及里最高的，问道：“高凯，这里是什么地方？”
“回殿下，这是逍遥阁，是个大型的综合交易所，很多小店都在里面租赁的摊位，一层二层是小的摊贩，三层以上是逍遥阁自己的店铺，四层是个拍卖行，会不定期的举行拍卖会，五层是内部交易行，那里只有拥有邀请函的人才能进去，我也不知道里面有什么。”
萧风听完后，说：“咱们也进去看看吧，如果有需要的大家也可以看看。”
当萧风走进逍遥阁后，发现大厅人确实是非常多的，甚至比刚刚在福运酒楼的人还多，萧风边走边看，突然在一个摊位上发现一个圆形玉佩，做工非常精美，他使用侦查术看了一下：
【名称：逍遥玉佩（封印中）】
【功效：佩戴者可免疫部分精神冲击】
果然不凡，单单这个免疫精神攻击，就非常的难得了，精神攻击是极其难修炼的，而且攻击手段也是防不胜防，如果能有个这样的玉佩，那无疑是对自身的一个保障。
萧风向着摊位走，拿起了摊位上的一把宝剑，看了起来，摊主见有人上前，也是赶紧起来招呼：“客观，这把宝剑可是黄阶宝剑，而且这个可是出自永兴工坊的，品质绝对没问题，而且这个把宝剑才一万两白银，非常划算的。”
萧风没有说话，又拿起了旁边的一柄刀，仔细端详了起来，其实这个摊位上的东西，萧风都已经用侦查术看过了，都是些普普通通的东西，于是开口问道：“这柄刀多少钱？”
“这是柄精钢打造的刀，也是也是永兴工坊出品的，虽然没有入品，但是也是不可多得的好刀，看公子气质不凡，就当交个朋友，五千两白银卖给公子。”
萧风笑了一下，放下那柄刀，对着老板说：“老板，既然交个朋友的话，那我给你一万两，让我在你摊子上挑三件东西得了。”
老板愣了一下，说道：“那就除了那把宝剑，你可以挑三件。”
萧风听后，直接给了老板一万两，随便挑了两件东西，然后把那枚玉佩收了起来，便向其他的摊位走去，众人也是跟在了萧风的后面，继续在里面逛着。
萧风他们来到了三楼，这里比下面要安静的多，人也相对较少，毕竟逍遥阁的出品是很好的，但是价格也是相对会高一些，萧风发现这里竟然还有酒楼，但是因为刚吃了东西，他们便没有进去。
萧风走进了一家卖药材的铺面，仔细的看了起来，众人中只有贾诩对药材感兴趣，贾诩也是买了一些制作毒丹的基础材料，当然，他还是买了很多其他的药材，以防止有心人看出他要炼制的丹药。
正在众人挑选药材的时候，一位身材曼妙的女子带着两位侍女走了进来，因为店铺内没什么人，那位女子进来后便发现了萧风，因为萧风的气质很像她认识的一位前辈，而且在店铺里闲逛的人也都是散落在萧风的周围，形成了保护的态势，女子对萧风突然感兴趣了，便向着萧风走来。
许褚看了一眼女子，看着她向萧风走来，便想上前阻拦，但是萧风却是暗中摆了摆手，因为在女子进门的时候，萧风就已经使用侦查术看过了，这女子是呼延墨岩的女儿，呼延欢颜。
萧风感觉着走近的呼延欢颜，扭头两人便四目相对，萧风微笑的看着呼延欢颜，但是呼延欢颜知道刚刚看萧风的感觉像哪位前辈了，是陛下，但是陛下的几个儿子她都是见过的，而眼前的这位他是一点印象没有，但是她还是回以微笑，但是并没有多说什么。
萧风看着呼延欢颜，确实是少有的美人胚子，很别致，但那时他此时却没有过多的想法，以他目前的状态，可不是风花雪月的时候，很多的事情都还是一团乱麻，随后萧风便与呼延欢颜擦身而过，领着众人离去了，只留下了呼延欢颜呆愣在原地，当她回过神来的时候，萧风早已消失在她的视野里了。
呼延欢颜转身便出了药店，在三楼寻找着萧风，但是还是没有发现萧风等人的身影，她说不清为什么要出来找个陌生人，但是心里好像就是有某种东西在牵引着她，随后便出了逍遥阁，坐在了门外的马车上，盯着逍遥阁门口，像是在这里还能再见到萧风一般。
萧风领着众人从逍遥阁出来后，便直接让高凯驾着马车回府了，因为刚刚有不良人来报，袁天罡已经在府里等后来了，而在马车里，萧风对贾诩说到：“文和，袁天罡已经带着情报到了府中，一会还要麻烦你好好来分析一下，咱们目前的状态了，还有就是发展方向。”
“好的少爷，少爷还有一件事，以后大家还是统一称呼你为殿下吧，毕竟咱们以后是要称霸大陆的，叫少爷好像有些不伦不类的。”贾诩低声回道。
“好，那就以后统一称呼殿下，是我当时考虑不周了。”萧风也是笑着说道。
“殿下，其实眼下有一个事情，我们可以借题发挥一下，当然这要看袁天罡带来的情报，我们怎么破一下局面。”
“什么事情？”
“殿下马上就要分王开府了，我想其他的几位皇子应该是不想看见这种情况发生的，我敢肯定这几天会有刺杀或者下毒的事情发生，袁天罡带来的情报如果能用的上的话，那么对我们来说可就是很好的一件事了。”
“嗯，这倒是破局的好办法，一切还是回府见了袁天罡再说吧。”
“殿下，到了。”高凯的声音在外面响起。

content_en:
Xiao Feng led everyone to walk on the streets of Xicheng, looking at the rows of shops around them, covering almost everything a warrior could practice, including exercises, pills, weapons, secret treasures. As long as you have money, you can buy almost everything you want. There are also some special professions derived here, such as doctors, poison masters, formation masters, etc.
There are also contact points for many aristocratic families and sects here. In order to obtain better training resources, many warriors who practice alone can only join these aristocratic families and sects. Otherwise, they can join the army and quickly obtain royal rewards. However, joining the army is more risky than these sects and aristocratic families.
Xiao Feng and his party were walking and saw a five-story building, which was the tallest building he could see. He asked, "Gao Kai, what is this place?"
"Back to Your Highness, this is Xiaoyao Pavilion. It is a large comprehensive exchange. There are many small shops renting stalls inside. Small vendors are on the first and second floors. Xiaoyao Pavilion's own shops are on the third and above floors. There is an auction house on the fourth floor, which will hold auctions from time to time. The fifth floor is an internal trading house. Only people with invitations can enter there. I don't know what's inside."
After Xiao Feng heard this, he said: "Let's go in and have a look. If you need it, everyone can take a look."
When Xiao Feng walked into Xiaoyao Pavilion, he found that there were indeed a lot of people in the hall, even more people than at Fuyun Restaurant just now. Xiao Feng looked around while walking, and suddenly found a round jade pendant on a stall. The workmanship was very exquisite. He used the detection technique to take a look:
[Name: Xiaoyao Jade Pendant (under seal)]
[Effect: The wearer can be immune to some mental shocks]
It is indeed extraordinary. This immunity to mental attacks alone is very rare. Mental attacks are extremely difficult to practice, and the attack methods are also difficult to guard against. If you can have such a jade pendant, it will undoubtedly be a guarantee for yourself.
Xiao Feng walked towards the stall and picked up a sword on the stall. When he looked at it, the stall owner hurriedly got up and greeted someone when he saw someone coming forward: "Objectively speaking, this sword is a yellow-grade sword, and it comes from Yongxing Workshop. The quality is absolutely no problem, and this sword only costs 10,000 taels of silver, which is very cost-effective."
Xiao Feng didn't say anything. He picked up a knife next to him and looked at it carefully. In fact, Xiao Feng had already used his investigative skills to look at the items in this stall. They were all ordinary things, so he asked, "How much does this knife cost?"
"This is a sword made of fine steel. It was also produced by Yongxing Workshop. Although it is not of high quality, it is still a rare and good knife. Seeing that the young master has extraordinary temperament, I made a friend and sold it to the young master for five thousand taels of silver."
Xiao Feng smiled, put down the knife, and said to the boss: "Boss, since you want to make a friend, I will give you ten thousand taels and let me pick three things from your stall."
The boss was stunned for a moment and said, "In addition to the sword, you can choose three items."
After hearing this, Xiao Feng directly gave the boss ten thousand taels, picked two items at random, then put the jade pendant away and walked to other stalls. Everyone followed Xiao Feng and continued to shop inside.
Xiao Feng and the others came to the third floor. It was much quieter than the one below, and there were relatively fewer people. After all, Xiaoyao Pavilion's products were very good, but the prices were relatively high. Xiao Feng found that there was a restaurant here, but because they had just eaten, they did not go in.
Xiao Feng walked into a shop selling medicinal materials and looked carefully. Among the people, only Jia Xu was interested in medicinal materials. Jia Xu also bought some basic materials for making poisonous elixirs. Of course, he also bought many other medicinal materials to prevent anyone from seeing the elixir he wanted to refine.
While everyone was selecting medicinal materials, a graceful woman came in with two maids. Since there was no one in the shop, the woman discovered Xiao Feng when she came in. Xiao Feng's temperament was very similar to that of a senior she knew, and the people wandering around the shop were also scattered around Xiao Feng, forming a protective posture. The woman suddenly became interested in Xiao Feng and walked towards Xiao Feng.
Xu Chu glanced at the woman, saw her walking towards Xiao Feng, and wanted to step forward to stop her, but Xiao Feng secretly waved his hand, because when the woman came in, Xiao Feng had already used his detection skills to see that this woman was the daughter of Huyan Moyan, Huyan Huanyan.
Xiao Feng felt Hu Yan Huan Yan approaching, and turned around, the two of them looked at each other. Xiao Feng looked at Hu Yan Huan Yan with a smile, but Hu Yan Huan Yan knew which senior she looked at Xiao Feng just now. It was His Majesty, but she had seen several of His Majesty's sons, and he had no impression of the one in front of her, but she still smiled back, but didn't say much.
Xiao Feng looked at Hu Yan Huanyan, who was indeed a rare beauty, very unique, but at that time he didn't think too much. In his current state, it was not the time of romance, and many things were still a mess. Then Xiao Feng passed by Hu Yanhuanyan and led everyone away, leaving Huyan Huanyan in a daze. When she came back to her senses, Xiao Feng had already disappeared from her sight.
Huyan Huanyan turned around and left the pharmacy, looking for Xiao Feng on the third floor, but she still didn't find Xiao Feng and others. She couldn't explain why she came out to find a stranger, but there seemed to be something pulling her in her heart. Then she left Xiaoyao Pavilion, sat on the carriage outside, and stared at the door of Xiaoyao Pavilion, as if she could see Xiao Feng again here.
After Xiao Feng led everyone out of Xiaoyao Pavilion, he asked Gao Kai to drive the carriage back to the house. Because a bad person had just come to report, Yuan Tiangang was already waiting at the house. In the carriage, Xiao Feng said to Jia Xu: "Wenhe, Yuan Tiangang has arrived at the house with information. I will trouble you to analyze our current situation and the direction of development later."
"Okay, young master, there is one more thing, young master. From now on, everyone should call you your highness. After all, we are going to dominate the mainland in the future, so calling you young master seems a bit inappropriate." Jia Xu replied in a low voice.
"Okay, then I will call you His Highness uniformly from now on. I didn't think carefully at the time." Xiao Feng also said with a smile.
"Your Highness, there is actually an issue at the moment that we can use as an excuse. Of course, it depends on the intelligence brought by Yuan Tiangang and how we can break the situation."
"What happened?"
"His Royal Highness is about to separate the princes and establish a palace. I think the other princes don't want to see this happen. I'm sure there will be assassinations or poisonings in the past few days. If the information Yuan Tiangang brings can be used, it will be a very good thing for us."
"Well, this is a good way to break the situation. Let's go back home and see Yuan Tiangang to discuss everything."
"Your Highness, we're here." Gao Kai's voice sounded outside.
